_comment: Written by the trading runs (9:30a / hourly / 3:30p ET). Never contains account numbers, broker IDs, or any account other than the sandbox.

account.note: PULLED LIVE AT 15:21 ET AGAINST THE MANDATED ACCOUNT BY THE HOURLY RUN, THE LAST SCHEDULED RUN BEFORE THE 15:30 FUSE. Portfolio, equity positions and option positions were each queried live and all three returned first time: 1009.16 total, 1009.16 cash, zero equity value, zero options value, zero pending deposits and ZERO unsettled, with buying_power reading 1009.16 to match. BOTH POSITION LISTS ARE EMPTY, which discharges the exit step rather than excusing it: no target, stop, time stop or option no-fly window is reachable because no position carries one. ZERO equity orders on a created_at floor of 2026-08-22, so the broker itself - not the empty position list - is what establishes that the 09:49 specification has not been executed. THE WHOLE BALANCE IS SETTLED, so the whole of it is deployable and no good-faith violation is reachable. ONE SPECIFICATION IS LIVE AGAINST IT AND IT IS RE-QUOTED AND CONFIRMED FOR THE SIXTH AND FINAL HOUR: 2 SMTC at a 138.50 limit, costing at most 277.00 - 27.4% of the account, inside the 40% single-name ceiling, leaving 732.16 uncommitted. THE HOUR'S FINDING IS THAT LAST HOUR'S FINDING REVERSED, AND FAST. At 14:21 this run recorded that the specification had stopped being marketable, resting 0.66 under the bid and needing a 0.47% give-back to fill. That give-back was offered fifteen minutes later. SMTC extended to a 140.360 high at 14:33 - the highest print of the afternoon - then broke back under the limit at 14:36 on a 137.640 low, and from 14:54 through 15:21 TWENTY-EIGHT CONSECUTIVE MINUTE BARS have traded at or below 138.50, with the 15:17 bar printing 137.110, the afternoon low and a 2.31% give-back from the high. The decisive volume was 32,826 and 57,046 shares in the 14:47 and 14:48 minutes - 89,872 in two minutes, inside a 102,433-share five-minute bucket that is the heaviest since 10:25 ET. SMTC is 137.71 bid / 137.87 ask at 19:21:44.44561001Z on a 0.116% spread, the tightest of the session, so the 138.50 limit now sits 0.63 ABOVE the ask and is IMMEDIATELY MARKETABLE ONCE MORE with nine minutes left to live. ALL THREE INVALIDATIONS WERE TESTED MECHANICALLY AND FOR THE SECOND CONSECUTIVE HOUR NOT ONE NARROWED: 2.96 on the 132.60 print test, unchanged for a third hour; 5.86 on the NVDA 205.00 test, WIDER than 5.58 an hour ago and a full retrace of the four-hour erosion into tonight's print; 2.285 on the 134.00 five-minute-close test, unchanged, with the volume half emphatically off at 11,576 shares against 23,902, down 51.6%. THE LIMIT IS NEITHER RAISED NOR LOWERED, AND THE REFUSAL TO RAISE IT AT 14:21 IS WHAT MADE THIS HOUR POSSIBLE: a limit moved to 139.16 to guarantee a fill would have bought the high of the afternoon and paid 1.45 more than the level that was there all along.

entryWatch.setup: SMTC post-earnings day 1 - reported 8/25 after the close, SPECIFIED at 09:49 at a 138.50 limit for 2 shares, FORCED on items 2 and 3, RE-QUOTED AND CONFIRMED at 10:22, 11:22, 12:21, 13:21, 14:21 and finally at 15:21
entryWatch.trigger: STILL LIVE AT 138.50, QUOTES CURRENT, INVALIDATIONS UNTOUCHED - AND THE SPECIFICATION IS MARKETABLE AGAIN, WHICH IS THIS HOUR'S REAL CONTENT AND THE EXACT REVERSAL OF LAST HOUR'S. SMTC is 137.71 bid / 137.87 ask at 2026-08-26T19:21:44.44561001Z, last 137.857, +8.11% against the 127.520 settled close, on a 0.116% spread - the tightest of the session. The 138.50 limit sits 0.63 ABOVE the ask, so for a BUY it is immediately fillable, and an operator executing now fills at 137.87 or better with the 127.42 stop and 166.20 target struck off a price never paid. THE 14:21 RUN SAID THE SPECIFICATION HAD STOPPED BEING MARKETABLE AND THAT FINDING HELD FOR FIFTEEN MINUTES. It recorded the limit resting 0.66 under the bid, needing a 0.47% give-back to fill. SMTC extended the 13:56 breakout to a 140.360 high in the 14:33 bar - the highest print of the afternoon and the highest since the open hour - and then rolled over. The 14:36 bar printed a 137.640 low, the first trade at or under 138.50 since 13:56 and the end of the twenty-five-bar streak the last run described. The decisive volume came at 14:47 and 14:48: 32,826 then 57,046 shares, 89,872 in two consecutive minutes, inside a five-minute bucket that traded 102,433 shares - the heaviest bucket since 10:25 ET, four hours and twenty minutes earlier. FROM 14:54 STRAIGHT THROUGH TO 15:21, TWENTY-EIGHT CONSECUTIVE MINUTE BARS HAVE TRADED AT OR BELOW THE LIMIT, and the 15:17 bar printed 137.110 - the low of the afternoon and a 2.31% give-back from the 14:33 high. THE MARKET CAME BACK TO THE LEVEL; IT WAS NOT CHASED THERE. THAT IS THE VINDICATION OF THE REFUSAL AND IT IS RECORDED AS ONE RATHER THAN CLAIMED AS SKILL. Every hour from 12:21 through 14:21 refused to move this limit - down to 136.50, down to 135.56, and last hour up to 139.16 to guarantee a fill on a name that had run 0.66 clear. Had it been raised to 139.16 at 14:21, the operator would be holding a fill 1.45 worse than the level that sat there the whole time, bought at the high of the afternoon. The pre-commitment the 09:49 body wrote by name and by hour produced that, and it produced it by doing nothing - the outcome that never generates evidence unless it is written down on the hour it works. ALL THREE PRE-REGISTERED INVALIDATIONS TESTED MECHANICALLY AT 15:21 AND FOR THE SECOND CONSECUTIVE HOUR NOT ONE NARROWED. FIRST, a print below 132.60: NOT TRIPPED by 2.96, unchanged for a third hour - the lowest post-publication print is still 135.560 from 12:47, and this hour's low of 137.110 sits 4.51 clear of the kill. SECOND, NVDA below 205.00: NOT TRIPPED at 210.86 bid, -1.03% on the day, and the buffer WIDENED AGAIN to 5.86 from 5.58, so the series reads 5.70, 5.67, 5.27, 5.10, 5.58, 5.86 and the four-hour erosion into tonight's print is fully retraced. It changes nothing about item 3, which fails on the event and not on the price: NVDA reports TONIGHT. THIRD, a five-minute close below 134.00 on rising volume: NOT TRIPPED, buffer 2.285 unchanged with the lowest completed post-publication five-minute close still 136.285 in the 12:40 bucket; this hour's lowest completed five-minute close was 138.245 at 15:10, above the shelf rather than below it, and THE VOLUME HALF IS EMPHATICALLY OFF at 11,576 shares against 23,902 in the 15:05 bucket, down 51.6% - the largest contraction of the session. Neither half is satisfied. THE STEP 2b TEST GETS ITS CLEANEST ANSWER OF THE DAY, AND IT IS A YES RATHER THAN A YES-WITH-CAVEATS. Last hour the honest answer was that the thesis was intact and the ENTRY had gone stale, because it was written to buy a give-back no longer on offer. At 137.71 bid the name is trading INSIDE the 137.50-138.24 shelf this entry was deliberately struck at - not above it, not below it, in it. The setup described at publication is the setup on the tape, the invalidation buffers are the widest they have been since publication, and the limit is fillable. THE LIMIT IS NEITHER RAISED NOR LOWERED, AND THIS HOUR NEITHER TEMPTATION EXISTS: the market is at the level rather than away from it in either direction. The 13:21 refusal to chase 135.56 downward and the 14:21 refusal to chase 139.16 upward both stand as written. LOGGED AND NOT ACTED ON: item 2 reads +8.11% on the last trade and +7.99% ON THE BID, the first bid reading under the +8% line since the +7.97% at 11:22. It changes nothing in this direction exactly as it changed nothing in the other - a forced marking is struck at publication and is not revised by a later tape. Six hours of readings run +13.47%, +8.40%, +7.97%, +8.10%, +8.40%, +9.23% and +8.11%, crossing the line four times, which is the entire argument for not revising it. NINE MINUTES REMAIN ON THE 15:30 FUSE AND THE OPERATOR WAS NOTIFIED. This is the last scheduled run before expiry. If SMTC is never bought this expires as the fifteenth consecutive unexecuted entry and the first to die with its named level having traded at length, on volume, and in the closing minutes - a delivery failure rather than a thesis failure. The 15:35 pre-close owns what follows and may not re-strike it.
entryWatch.why: FORCED ON ITEMS 2 AND 3 AND CLEAN ON THE OTHER FOUR. Item 1 is a 24.6% beat - Q2 EPS 0.71 against a 0.57 estimate, verified on a live calendar pull. Item 5 is the reason it ranks first and it is the strongest on the board: SMTC was marked DOWN 21.6% into its own print, 154.22 on 8/17 to a 120.91 close on 8/24, on 8,904,562 shares on 8/25 against a ~2.3M average - expectations cut into the report, not raised into it - and the beat came in bigger than the markdown, with the 138.50 limit still 10.2% below the 8/17 high. Item 4 passes on a 0.17% spread and 45k-82k share minutes through the breakout. ITEM 2 FAILS OUTRIGHT at +13.90%, with the whole board green alongside it (ANF +28.4%, BZ +15.2%), which item 2's second sentence calls a wait signal. ITEM 3 FAILS ON PULLED NUMBERS: NVDA reports TONIGHT and its 8/28 212.50 straddle is 12.55 against a 211.93 spot, a 5.92% implied move at 94% IV landing inside the five-session window; SMTC's own 9/18 135 straddle is 23.55 on ~137, 17.2% over 23 days at 82% IV - elevated even with SMTC's own earnings behind it, which is the spillover being priced - scaling by sqrt(5/23) to 8.0% against an 8% stop, putting the stop exactly on the one-sigma line. Options were priced and refused on spread for the fifth session running: the 9/18 135 call is 14.20/16.00 at 11.9% of mark and the put 7.90/9.00 at 13.0%, both outside the 10% ceiling, on the only expiry satisfying the 3-6 week rule since SMTC lists no weeklies. THE NVDA COLLISION IS NAMED, NOT BURIED: this board committed on 8/21 and again in the 8/25 pre-close to being flat into tonight's print, and this entry contradicts that. The 15:35 pre-close owns the overnight decision explicitly on live quotes.

entryWatch.setup: BZ post-earnings day 2 - the 8/25 specification at 15.95 expired unexecuted and is NOT re-struck
entryWatch.trigger: REFUSED TODAY ON THIS BOARD'S OWN MOST-REFUSED BEHAVIOUR, WHICH IS THE POINT WORTH RECORDING. BZ is 18.73 bid / 18.77 ask at 2026-08-26T13:53:00.508516304Z, last 18.760, +15.16% against the 16.290 close, on a 0.21% spread. Yesterday's thesis was RIGHT and delivery is what failed: a fill at 15.95 would now be +2.81 a share, +17.6%. That does not make BZ buyable at 18.73. Buying it here is re-striking a dead 15.95 limit 17.4% higher to chase a name that got away, which is exactly what the 2026-08-18 change forbids - widening the time is not permission to widen the price - and it is the refusal this board has already made at FUTU 117.90 and twice at BJ 97.35. It is now made against this board's own entry, which is the harder version and the one that counts. DAY 2 IS ALSO A CONTINUATION SPIKE, NOT THE PULLBACK ITEM 2 PREFERS: BZ opened 16.765, ran to 19.00 by 09:39 and has held 18.5-18.9 since, so there has been no give-back to buy at any point today.
entryWatch.why: The 8/25 entry was FORCED on item 2, confirmed six times by the hourly runs with all three pre-registered invalidations tested at each and none ever tripped, and it died on its 15:30 fuse with the closing bid 16.225 against the 15.95 limit - the fourteenth consecutive unexecuted entry. It was not carried overnight because a specification that outlives its session is a standing instruction resting on a tape that no longer exists. Today's tape vindicates the reasoning and changes nothing about the rule: the level is dead, and a dead level does not come back to life because the name went up.

candidatesNote: Re-quoted at 15:21 ET on 8/26 by the final hourly run for the two names that carry a live decision - SMTC, the specified name, and NVDA, which is invalidation two. candidates.note: RE-QUOTED AT 15:21 BY THE FINAL HOURLY RUN: 137.71 bid / 137.87 ask at 19:21:44.44561001Z, last 137.857, +8.11% against a 127.520 close on a 0.116% spread - the tightest of the session. The limit now sits 0.63 ABOVE the ask and fills at 137.87 or better. THE THESIS IS UNCHANGED AND WAS NOT RE-ARGUED THIS HOUR. Q2 EPS 0.710 against 0.570, a 24.6% beat, on a name marked DOWN 21.6% into its own print - 154.22 on 8/17 to a 120.91 close on 8/24 - on 8,904,562 shares on 8/25 against a ~2.3M average. ITEM 2 NOW READS +8.11% on the last and +7.99% ON THE BID, the first bid reading under the +8% line since 11:22, after +9.23% at 14:21, +8.40% at 13:21, +8.10% at 12:21 and +7.97% at 11:22. Logged on both sides of the line four times across six hours and NOT ACTED ON: a forced marking is struck at publication and is not revised by a later tape in either direction. Item 3 still fails on the NVDA print tonight. The forced marking stands, and the limit is neither raised to chase the 140.36 high nor lowered to chase the 135.56 low. Nine minutes remain on the 15:30 fuse.

139.76 bid / 140.40 ask at 13:53:01.472625787Z, last 140.085, +28.64% against a 108.900 close on a 0.46% spread. THE STRONGEST TAPE ON THE BOARD AND REFUSED ON NUMBERS OVER NARRATIVE. It gapped, ran to 141.92, gave back 3.7% to 136.59 and rebuilt to the highs - a genuine intraday pullback-and-reclaim, the healthiest structure here. The refusal is that a 2.42 against 2.37 EPS beat, up 2.1%, cannot be reconciled with a 28.6% move from any number this run pulled: the driver is guidance or comps I cannot see, so buying it means buying a story rather than an arithmetic. It is also a new three-month high, well above the 119.92 high of 8/11, so item 5 reads the wrong way - this is not a name recovering from a markdown, it is one being re-rated into clear air.

18.73 bid / 18.77 ask at 13:53:00.508516304Z, last 18.760, +15.16% against a 16.290 close on a 0.21% spread. Day 2 of the print this board specified yesterday at 15.95, and REFUSED because buying it now is re-striking a dead limit 17.4% higher - the FUTU and BJ refusal applied to this board's own entry. Yesterday's reasoning was right: a fill at 15.95 would be +17.6% now. Delivery failed, not the thesis, and the rule that follows is that widening the time is not permission to widen the price.

130.49 bid / 130.89 ask at 13:52:58.538298541Z, last 130.730, +4.05% against a 125.450 close on a 0.31% spread. Q1 3.24 against 2.22, a 45.9% beat - the largest on the board that the tape did not reject - and the only large-beat name that passes item 2 literally. REFUSED ON ITEM 5: it went INTO the print at the top of a month-long grind, 117.50 on 8/3 to a 125.87 close on 8/24, so expectations were raised into this report rather than cut. The WMT arithmetic applies on top: +20% is 156.88 inside five sessions, which a staples name does not produce, so the exits would be decoration. Faded from a 134.85 open to 130.49, which is the tape agreeing.

30.53 bid / 30.73 ask at 13:53:01.316029278Z, last 30.590, +4.13% against a 29.320 close on a 0.65% spread. A 25% beat (0.50 against 0.40) and THE CLEAREST DISTRIBUTION DAY ON THE BOARD: it opened 37.48, printed 37.91, and has fallen 19.3% from that high with no floor established - a fresh low at 09:41 and lower again by 09:53. Buying it is catching a knife on print day, and it carries the same NVDA event gap as every other semi-cap name into tonight.

16.51 bid / 16.55 ask at 13:52:58.304121771Z, last 16.530, -6.50% against a 17.680 close on a 0.24% spread. EPS 1.28 against 0.55, a 133% beat, AND THE STOCK IS DOWN - it spiked to 17.77 in the second minute and was sold to 16.02. This is item 5 firing the other way: the beat was not the story and the tape said so within two minutes. A beat the market rejects is not a catalyst, it is a warning.

17.56 bid / 17.61 ask at 13:53:03.19769886Z, last 17.5805, +0.00% against a 17.580 close on a 0.28% spread. EPS 0.62 against 0.21, a 195% beat, and the stock is EXACTLY unchanged. Looked at as a sympathy laggard against ANF's +28.6% in the same complex and refused: it is not a name that has not been looked at, it is a name that was looked at and priced. The tape confirms it - opened 18.26, printed 18.73, and bled all morning to 17.43. Not moving would be one thing; going down on a 195% beat is another.

344.23 bid / 344.65 ask at 13:53:01.68357106Z, last 344.430, -3.65% against a 357.460 close on a 0.12% spread. EPS 4.03 against 3.29, a 22.5% beat, and it is DOWN 3.65% and making session lows - crowded bulls into a print meeting a merely-good report, which is item 5 in the textbook shape. One share is also 34.1% of the account, so a two-share position is impossible inside the 40% ceiling regardless of the view.

94.39 bid / 94.43 ask at 13:53:03.204780357Z, last 94.420, +1.42% against a 93.100 close on a 0.04% spread - the tightest quote on this board. Day 2, a genuine grinding continuation off a 7.8% beat, and THE ONLY NAME HERE THAT PASSES ITEM 2 BOTH LITERALLY AND IN SPIRIT. Refused twice over: the WMT arithmetic (+20% is 113.27 on a Canadian bank inside five sessions, which is not a number it produces) and consistency - this board refused BNS in writing yesterday at 89.52 and it is 5.4% higher today, so re-entering is the same dead-level-higher error being refused at BZ.
